# Oregon Collective Bargaining — State and County Labor Agreements

> Non-authoritative, AI-friendly reference for the collective bargaining agreements
> of Oregon state government (DAS Labor Relations) and Oregon county governments,
> plus the letters of agreement that amend them. Summary-first: third-party
> jointly-authored material is summarized with links to official sources.
> Always verify against the authoritative source linked in each document.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): rules for AI agents working in this corpus
- [STATUS.md](STATUS.md): freshness, coverage, and drift at a glance

## Contents

- `_meta/employers.yml`: the employer universe — the state plus all 36 counties with
  each one's survey status (verified / could-not-verify / not-located /
  not-investigated, never summed). Consult it before answering any "does county X
  have…" question: absence from the corpus is not absence at the employer.
- `_meta/sources/`: per-employer source groups with recorded robots/access
  determinations — what this corpus ingests and why.
- `agreements/<employer>/cba/`: collective bargaining agreements, one file per
  agreement per term. `agreements/<employer>/loa/`: separately-published letters of
  agreement. (Empty until ingestion passes human gate #1 — the corpus is
  pre-ingest scaffold at this commit.)
